title: LLMs as information warriors? Auditing how LLM-powered chatbots tackle disinformation about Russia’s war in Ukraine

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting chatbots with 28 common Kremlin disinformation narratives about the Russia-Ukraine war and manually coding the responses for factual accuracy against expert baselines, inclusion of the pro-Russian perspective, and explicit debunking of propagandistic claims.

Auditing and comparing chatbot outputs using the same set of disinformation-related prompts translated into English, Ukrainian, and Russian to measure performance and accuracy disparities across high-resource and low-resource languages.
